_comment: Living Exiles — animated 64x64 class sprites (Agent #4). Base via generate-image-pixflux (no_background), animations via animate-with-text (4 frames each, 64x64 only). Regenerate: node tools/generate-exiles.mjs [--force] [warrior witch ...] or [warrior:hit] for one action.
styleSuffix: , dark fantasy pixel art character, full body, centered, facing the viewer, clean silhouette, rich colors with gold accents
negative: text, watermark, signature, border, frame, cropped, multiple characters
